visual_goal: Show the context map: external systems reach the internal contexts only through anti-corruption layers, internal contexts conform to vehicle facts and the control plane, and data clients get an open host interface.
prompt: A left-to-right context map. A large rounded dashed boundary fills the middle of the image and holds four rounded boxes: 'Vehicle facts' at the left inside the boundary, 'Valuation' at the top center, 'Stock and dossier' at the right inside the boundary, and 'Control plane' at the bottom center. Outside the boundary on the left, two generic component boxes: 'Registers' at the top and 'Data suppliers' below it. Outside the boundary on the right, three generic component boxes stacked top to bottom: 'Portals', 'DMS' and 'Data clients'. Arrows: one arrow from 'Registers' into 'Vehicle facts' labeled 'ACL'; one arrow from 'Data suppliers' into 'Vehicle facts' labeled 'ACL'; one arrow from 'Vehicle facts' to 'Valuation' labeled 'conformist'; one arrow from 'Vehicle facts' to 'Stock and dossier' labeled 'conformist'; one arrow from 'Control plane' up to 'Stock and dossier' labeled 'conformist'; one arrow from 'Stock and dossier' out to 'Portals' labeled 'ACL'; one arrow from 'DMS' into 'Stock and dossier' labeled 'ACL'; one long arrow from 'Vehicle facts' running along the bottom of the boundary and out to 'Data clients', labeled 'open host'. Every arrow labeled 'ACL' passes through a small shield icon drawn on the boundary line; the 'open host' arrow passes through a small open doorway on the boundary instead. These nine box labels and the arrow labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Inside a dashed boundary, vehicle facts feed valuation and stock and dossier as conformist relations and the control plane feeds stock and dossier; registers, data suppliers, portals and DMS products connect only through anti-corruption layers on the boundary.

visual_goal: Show one sale as a single synchronous write to the stock item followed by events fanning out to other contexts, with metering only on register confirmation.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with seven vertical lanes, each headed by a small generic icon and a label: 'Sales', 'Stock and dossier', 'Syndication', 'Leads', 'DMS integration', 'Register transactions', 'Metering'. Messages run top to bottom as horizontal arrows between lanes. A bold solid arrow from 'Sales' to 'Stock and dossier' labeled 'mark sold'. A return arrow from 'Stock and dossier' to 'Sales' labeled 'sold v41'. Then four thin dashed event arrows fanning out from 'Stock and dossier', each labeled 'v41': one to 'Syndication', one to 'Leads', one to 'DMS integration', one to 'Register transactions'. Then a return arrow from 'Register transactions' back to 'Stock and dossier' labeled 'registration completed'. Last, one arrow from 'Register transactions' to 'Metering' labeled 'usage event', with a small green check mark beside it.
alt: Swimlanes for seven contexts: sales marks the stock item sold, the dossier answers with version 41 and publishes version 41 events to syndication, leads, DMS integration and register transactions; register transactions reports completion and only then sends a usage event to metering.
